meaning:
ἀφ-ικνέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX for בּוֹא, etc. ;]
perfective of ἱκνέομαι, to come (M, Pr., 247), to arrive at, come to, reach: metaphorically (MM, see word), Rom.16:19.†
(AS)
